users_phone_or_email.name: users_phone_or_email
users_phone_or_email.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

stock_units_has_number.name: stock_units_has_number
stock_units_has_number.value: "stock_units"."imei" is not null or "stock_units"."serial" is not null

ledger_lines_account_reference.name: ledger_lines_account_reference
ledger_lines_account_reference.value: ("ledger_lines"."account" = 'supplier_payable') = ("ledger_lines"."supplier_id" is not null) and ("ledger_lines"."account" = 'money_place') = ("ledger_lines"."money_place_id" is not null)

deliveries_period_matches_type.name: deliveries_period_matches_type
deliveries_period_matches_type.value: ("deliveries"."payment_type" in ('within_time', 'after_sold_with_latest_date')) = ("deliveries"."payment_period_value" is not null and "deliveries"."payment_period_unit" is not null) and (("deliveries"."payment_period_value" is null) = ("deliveries"."payment_period_unit" is null))

suppliers_period_matches_type.name: suppliers_period_matches_type
suppliers_period_matches_type.value: ("suppliers"."payment_type" in ('within_time', 'after_sold_with_latest_date')) = ("suppliers"."payment_period_value" is not null and "suppliers"."payment_period_unit" is not null) and (("suppliers"."payment_period_value" is null) = ("suppliers"."payment_period_unit" is null))

suppliers_phone_unless_waiting.name: suppliers_phone_unless_waiting
suppliers_phone_unless_waiting.value: "suppliers"."phone" is not null or "suppliers"."status" = 'waiting' or ("suppliers"."status" = 'hidden' and "suppliers"."hidden_from" = 'waiting')
